column1: # Where each Warcraft III patch program comes from (read by scripts/fetch-patch-programs.sh).
# Only public mirrors, never Blizzard's own servers. English, Windows.
# Columns (tab-separated): version  game  source  member-in-zip-or-dash  saved-as
# source is a URL, or file:// for a copy already on this machine.
# Order doesn't matter here; version order comes from the version table (issue 112b).
# 1.29.2: no patch program exists (launcher-only from 1.28); its data archives
# and the two programs that prove its version are kept from a whole-game copy.
# From the Gamefront collection's third part (W-Z) on the Internet Archive: single
# files served out of the 7 GB archive, so only the programs listed are downloaded.
# From the "Warcraft 3 Collection" on the Internet Archive (each with a published sha512).
# 1.28.5: no patch program; its data archives and programs, from Hive Workshop's file
# 1.29.1: the same layout as 1.29.2 (no War3Patch.mpq), from Hive Workshop's file pack.
# Incremental patches (one version to the next), kept apart in incremental/ so the
# stack doesn't build them: a cross-check. Applied to the lower version's layer, each
# must reproduce the higher version's layer (src/tests/test_patch_layers.lua).
